provenance_note_zh: 本文件只保存 Sun et al. (2024) Table 13 的四条规则原文（短引用），用于补充案例的非 LLM 基线；不包含任何受限语料。正式版未取得。

rules.text: The process of phone company must be terminated if it takes more than 30 days for any reason.
After receiving the customer's personal information, it is necessary to verify the correctness of their personal information.
When the customer receives the sim card, the phone company must activate the sim card so that the customer can use the sim card normally.
Before retrieving any kind of personal data from the Data Subject, the Data Controller has to ask the Data Subject for consent.

paper_reading_text.statement: R1 and R4 = missing action; R2 = out-of-order execution; R3 = incorrect actor

paper_reading_figure.statement: V1/R1 and V2/R2 = Missing Action; V3/R3 = Incorrect Actor; V4/R4 = Out-of-order Execution

conflict_note_zh: 两种读法在 R2 与 R4 上互换；正式版未取得，二者都只作文献原始声明，均不作可靠 Gold。
